name: Zottman Curl
research: Both arms together (right mirrors left). Start: arms hanging, elev 7 / plane 56 / elbow 13, palms forward (axis +x, index outward). End: top of the curl, elbow 124, palms turned down (axis -x, index toward the midline = pronated). Angles from the approved dumbbell_curl clip; range per S1 Marcolin 2018 (123 +- 12 deg). The small +y (0.12) in both axes keeps the in-between frames from passing through a zero-length handle axis (a straight +x -> -x blend would hit (0,0,0) at the halfway frame). Why the turn matters: S2 Kleiber 2015, brachioradialis share higher when pronated. Facts: research/zottman_curl.json.
